description: Generate an AI Hit Chart for a specific target (product or standard) from a previous search. A Hit Chart maps patent claim elements to product features element-by-element with evidence. SPENDS 1 CHART CREDIT and asks first: the initial call returns a quote naming the target it matched and runs nothing, and the chart is generated only when you call again with confirm: true after the user agrees. Use this when the user asks to chart, map claims, or analyse a specific target in detail.

confirm.description: Set true only after showing the user the quote from the unconfirmed call and getting their agreement. Without it, nothing is run and nothing is charged.

search_id.description: The search ID from a previous claimhit_search

target_name.description: The exact name of the product or standard to chart e.g. "Samsung Galaxy S25" or "5G NR Release 17"

name: claimhit_generate_chart
title: Generate claim chart
